intro: Hey everyone, we are excited to introduce a faster way to export reports in Acme.

scenes.text: Here's the reports page, with this quarter's numbers.
Pick a format, hit export, and the file is ready in a second.
And every column from the screen comes along with it.

outro: Before this, exports took a support ticket. Now it's one click. Thanks for watching!

intro.title: One-click report exports
intro.subtitle: Export any report to CSV or Excel.

outro.title: Exports without the wait
outro.subtitle:
Before: a support ticket.
After: one click.
